business.description: Lexoraa Industries Limited (formerly known as Servoteach Industries Limited) is a company listed on BSE Limited with CIN L32111MH1994PLC081857.

products.name: Jewellery, Gems & Precious Metals
products.note: Expansion into jewellery sector encompassing gold, silver, diamonds, pearls, precious stones, bullion, artefacts, and related products, including trading, import, export, and establishment of showrooms.

products.name: Agro & Food Products
products.note: Diversification into trading, import, export, and distribution of agricultural, horticultural, and other agro-based products including fruits, vegetables, edible oils, organic foods, dairy products, health foods, protein foods, fast-moving consumer goods, and packaged foods.

products.name: Manufacturing & Processing
products.note: Continuing capabilities in manufacturing, repairing, distributing, and dealing in machinery, equipment, tools, solvent extraction, refining, vanaspati, cattle feed, oil milling, and chemical processing.

products.note: Appears as finished goods in inventory note 18

outlook.statement: The Company aims to consolidate its position in the jewellery sector and expand its footprint across domestic and export markets. The jewellery business is expected to act as a key growth driver, supported by increasing consumer demand and favourable industry dynamics.

The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on 3rd July, 2026, approved the raising of funds by way of a Rights Issue aggregating up to ₹69 Crores, through the offer and issuance of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company having a face value of ₹10/- each at an issue price of ₹18/- per equity share (including a premium of 8/- per equity share) to the eligible equity shareholders of the Company.

The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on 1st April, 2026, approved the acquisition of 100% Equity Shares of Any and Every Export Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong. Upon completion of the acquisition, Any and Every Export Limited became a Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company.

The long-term growth prospects of Industry continue to remain grim. The threats to the Company's products include severe competition both in domestic market through increased Inflation, labour cost, Interest rates, etc.
Your director perceives that the business of the company stands on a normal ground & hope to improve in the coming years.
Company intends to continue operations under revised business model; promoters/management committed to explore new business opportunities and infuse additional funds
